objective: give a concise, non-banter durability cue in response to skincare wearing off during a hot event

sourcePost.observedText: All the skincare I applied don melt finish for GT.

careBoundary: General sun-protection education only. Water resistance is a product-label category, not a promise that skincare cannot wipe off. Reapplication remains necessary after sweating. No exact product, price, stock, savings, suitability or clinical claim.

copy.post: Try a water-resistant sunscreen next time.
copy.headline: For hot, sweaty days: Choose a water-resistant sunscreen.
copy.labelCue: Look for the words ‘Water resistant’ on the product label.
